guidance: Keep security contacts up to date with a monitored distribution list (2-3 people) so AWS can alert your team about abuse, exposed credentials, or incidents. Use a secure mail server for the contact address, as it can be used to reset the root password. Manage security contacts centrally via AWS Organizations to avoid updating each account individually.
how_to_check: Are security contacts defined for all accounts, using a distribution list rather than an individual? Is the information current? Verify with Security Hub control Account.1. For more information, please refer to the documentation.
